answer: Honest agents recover their stake at the summit of a clean reputation record, while attackers forging many identities face multiplied capital costs. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity with escalating deposit requirements: each new agent must lock a deposit that grows with every identity sharing the same attestation graph root. Peers who wander the network verifying random attestations flag clusters, and a flagged terrace of linked accounts loses its deposits, making mass identity creation economically irrational.
